model: Kea DHCPv4 server (kea-dhcp4, memfile lease backend), Debian 12 package kea-dhcp4-server 2.2.0-6

capture.command: apt-get install kea-dhcp4-server; kea-dhcp4 -c /etc/kea/kea-dhcp4.conf on docker network fxlab-e (server 10.250.70.67, ISC dhcpd stopped first); four busybox:1.37 (busybox@sha256:a7dbc319b1438115a207e11930dc4bb3e643dcb3ec0bdd694bb36cd8fad289ec) clients ran `udhcpc -i eth0 -f -q -n -x hostname:<name> -s /bin/true` for nas-04, cam-05, kiosk-06, guest-07 (guest-07 with -R; its release did not reach the server before the client exited, so the lease stayed active) and obtained real leases; then the collector's exact dhcp.KeaScript("/etc/kea/kea-dhcp4.conf", "/var/lib/kea/kea-leases4.csv") was fed to `docker exec -i fxlab-e-dhcp sh` and stdout saved unmodified.

files.name: transcript.txt
files.description: stdout of KeaScript: @@OPENMAP:config@@ (kea-dhcp4.conf with // comments) and @@OPENMAP:leases@@ (memfile CSV written by kea-dhcp4)
